title: RAHHH
blurb: Primal, wordless, and somehow expressing peak hype, peak rage and peak patriotism at the same time. There is no content here at all — it is pure intensity with the meaning left entirely to context, which is why it turns up over gym personal bests, game-winning plays, and edits involving an eagle and a flag with equal frequency. Grammar is optional; volume is not. Press the button and let the intrusive hype win, ideally somewhere you will not have to explain yourself afterwards. Nobody has ever said this quietly.
origin: The viral maximum-intensity scream of hype culture.
